concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-hold-in-escrow-node]] - Braintree Marketplace-specific Node.js hold-in-escrow invocation by transaction ID, limited to `authorized` or `submitted_for_settlement` transactions and preserving the empty-handler result boundary
warnings: Preserve Braintree Marketplace merchant scope; do not generalize the operation to every Braintree merchant.
Retain the exact eligible input statuses `authorized` and `submitted_for_settlement` without importing how they were reached or what later transitions occur.
The callback and Promise handlers are empty; do not infer result properties, success tests, returned status or completion from them.
Do not import release, cancellation, settlement, disbursement, timing or other escrow lifecycle behavior from the operation name or unread references.
